svg.title: Week 4: calibration under exposure shift
svg.desc: 4 frozen Week 3 models, evaluated on time-aligned standard and randomized final impressions. Shared-axis click log-loss bars compare raw scores with standard and randomized Platt calibration; lower is better.
svg.text: Frozen Week 3 models · final time holdout · click log loss (nats / impression) ↓
Random Platt uses earlier randomized labels; both final cohorts remain held out. Same y-axis in every panel.
Source: artifacts/week4_results.json · Final test window: 2022-04-30 to 2022-05-08 UTC
